I have always cared for these fruit trees using the knowledge passed down from my mother, so I will apply manure from our livestock to keep the soil fertile rather than buying costly chemicals that I do not know how to use. My family and I will tend this small plot ourselves through weeding, pruning, and harvest, as we cannot afford to hire outside workers and the plot is not large. I will not use pesticides or irrigation because they are too expensive and the rains have been enough for these trees over the years.
